items.title: Formal parameterized fluid systems and observables
items.scope: Definitions of classical pointwise formal PDEs; model quantities/units and primitive/derived interpretation separate.

items.title: Exact Reynolds and Mach nondimensionalization
items.scope: Positive U,L and chosen reference density/speed; algebra only, no incompressible or turbulent limit theorem.

items.title: Acoustic and inertial finite-mode solutions
items.scope: Smooth finite Fourier modes of explicitly defined linear PDEs; c²>0 for acoustic oscillations; negative c² instability separately proved.

items.title: Finite-depth gravity-wave dispersion with quantitative limits
items.scope: Smooth linear potential boundary problem, h,g,k>0; shallow squared-frequency error <=(kh)²/3 and deep error <=2exp(-2kh). No nonlinear error.

items.title: Plane and pipe Couette–Poiseuille verification
items.scope: Infinite/fully developed channel or pipe ansatz; axis C² regularity; exact NS/Stokes solution for all Re, uniqueness only within ansatz.

items.title: Vortex topology and global-Bernoulli counterexamples
items.scope: Punctured-axis smooth vortex and solid rotation; prescribed pressures; no global scalar potential or common Bernoulli constant without hypotheses.

items.title: Exterior sphere Stokes solution, force and decay-class uniqueness
items.scope: Exterior r>a smooth Stokes problem, no-slip sphere, constant far field; explicit O(r^-1)/O(r^-2) velocity/gradient/pressure decay class; exact 6πμaU force. Assumes ACω for bounded-domain divergence integration.

items.title: Bounded-domain Stokes residual estimate
items.scope: Existing C² Stokes-difference field, C¹ up to bounded C¹ boundary, zero trace and stated Poincare bound; explicit box constant h; no existence theorem. Assumes ACω for bounded-domain divergence integration.

items.title: Exact viscous diffusion layer and material-circulation decay
items.scope: t>0,y>0 initial-wall corner excluded; exact layer bound and separately smooth periodic sine-shear material loop.

items.title: Barotropic Kelvin and Bernoulli with exact hypotheses
items.scope: C² smooth barotropic Euler, positive density and conservative body force; C¹ advected loop with continuous mixed derivatives; steady Bernoulli; connected component global constant only if irrotational.

items.title: Conditional nonlinear Couette energy stability
items.scope: Existing smooth NS perturbation periodic in x,z, zero trace y=0,h; decay if |S|h²/ν<2 on its existence interval; neither sharp threshold nor global3D regularity. Assumes ACω for bounded-domain divergence integration.

items.title: Linear vortex-sheet growing modes
items.scope: Equal density harmonic linear interface model, no gravity/surface tension; k>0 and nonzero velocity jump gives real exponential growth; no nonlinear transition claim.

items.title: Exterior potential sphere and zero ideal force
items.scope: Explicit smooth potential on exterior sphere, slip/no-through condition; exact inviscid Euler pressure force zero; not viscous/no-slip.
